parameters.description:
`msg-to-join` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Join destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional Join destinations bound per enrollment.

Visit joinjoaomgcd.appspot.com and authorize it against your Google account, then install the Join app (from the Play Store) on the device(s) you want to notify and sign in with that same account. Refresh joinjoaomgcd.appspot.com — your device now appears, and the site shows your personal API key; set it as JOIN_APIKEY. Set JOIN_TARGETS to the device ID or name you want to notify, or use group.all to reach every device.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Join destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Join apikey

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Join targets
